The actors are dressed in various suits and semi-formal wear, with the individual on the far right holding a microphone. (2) The camera zooms in closer to focus on the four actors. The primary speaker in the grey suit gestures with his free hand while talking into the microphone. To his left, a man in a black satin traditional-style jacket stands with a slight smile. Beside him, an actor in a light blue oversized blazer over dark trousers stands with one hand in his pocket. The lighting is dominated by a warm, vibrant red glow from the screen, creating a high-contrast cinematic atmosphere. (3) The speaker continues his address, looking out toward the unseen audience. The other three actors remain in relaxed poses, smiling and occasionally nodding. The camera movement is slightly shaky, indicating a handheld recording. The setting is clearly a large-scale promotional event with professional production elements and intense stage lighting that emphasizes the red and black color scheme of the show's branding.
